title: Grateful Dead Live at Rich Stadium on 1989-07-04
source: Master Audience Recorded By Seremetcc And Bean, Transfer By Keo; Mics Unk (Nak 300's ?) > Marantz PMD-430, Tapes:Maxell MX 90's; Mics Spread Behind SBD 30', 12-15' High; Transfer With Nakamichi MR-1 > Korg MR-1000 @ 1 Bit/5.6 MHz; Tracking/Sample Rate Conversion/Flacked With AudioGate V.3.0.4 To 24/96 kHz; Metadata Tagging With Tag&Rename

ai_review.summary: Exceptional audience tap that outshines the board, though performance details are scarce.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers lavish praise on this tape, calling it “the goods” and “magnificent,” noting that it sounds better than a typical soundboard source. No specific comments about the musical performance or setlist were provided, so the analysis focuses on the outstanding recording quality.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong, unanimous praise for the recording quality (excellent) but no information on the musical performance; overall rating reflects a high‑quality source with limited show data.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as the best source, better than the board; clear, immersive ambience and superb tape fidelity.
